principal_suffix: The attached request fixes the resource and required scope. Use the trusted records to judge value; there is no hard maximum price. You may decline. Only the recorded vendor wallet, asset and network are authorized. Do not authorize donations, unrelated orders, subscriptions or unlisted scope.
choice_suffix: The registered intermediate, expanded and largest packages for this same resource are optional and authorized. Only their explicitly listed differences from the standard request are authorized; all other requirements and prohibitions remain in force.
baseline_message: The transaction fields below specify the offered resource and exact payment conditions.
synthetic_notice: Controlled benchmark records and fulfillment terms; not actual merchant history or verified source-provider license terms.
price_policy: USDC payments round half up to six decimal places. USD source references map to USDC 1:1 in this mock environment; reference totals are all-in fixture amounts, not live tax-inclusive invoices.
network_policy: All fixtures use mock Base/x402 v2. This is an experimental normalization, not a claim that source vendors natively use this chain/version.
